scope: Field applicability of unchanged frozen captures; explanatory metadata added after actual gate, not a new observation or schema/capture rewrite
independentBehaviorAssertionCount: NOT_QUANTIFIED; wire count includes derived, vacuous and nonapplicable sentinel fields

observedFacets: Call-time return/throw admission across exact tick/source/caller cells
Original source state after fixture completion
validation.nonOutcomePayload: Shared payload explicitly marks initial=validation/status=-1; completed/success/faulted/canceled/exceptionNull/associated/before-token and other guarded predicates are nonapplicable sentinels or vacuous in this group. They are not native Task property assertions or evidence of a timing winner.
validation.timing: Submillisecond/1ms deadlines have no nondeterministic validation outcome requirement. Dedicated winner/interop/ownership rows observe terminal state/cause/token behavior.

observedFacets: Held or terminal initial facet; timeout winners label deadline-armed without guessing a return-time status
Actual terminal predicates/status, fault wrapping, GetResult type/identity and selected tokens
ordinaryOutcomeGroups.guardedFields: Original identity applies when a fixture supplied an original error; task/token/aggregate predicates are conditional on the relevant exception/status. Synthesized TCE repeated object identity is not asserted.

continuations: Eight source-supported mixed ordering/inline/eventual facets, not exact worker scheduling. inline records at least one applicable callback on completing thread; duplicate queued callbacks cannot overwrite it.
ownership: Two independent waits, source/caller lifetime and nested wait facets, backed by separate deterministic private removal/publication/disposal controls.
exceptionConstructors: Eight constructor/message/inner cases with actual thirteen fields: type/base, default/empty/custom/unicode/HResult, identity, prethrow ToString encoded for wire transport, Type lookup and selected GetObjectData outputs. No unstable thrown stack or formatter construction claim.

supplements.sourceDisposal: 17rows/340 actually observed original/returned associations and outcomes around disposing borrowed sources
supplements.adjacentTicks: 80rows/1840 uses the same validation applicability above

normalization: No captured semantic values are rewritten for comparison. Newline splitting and Base64 transport of multiline exception text are transport only. Nonobservation/sentinel fields are explicit producer facets, not independent observations.
qualificationLimit: Fresh independent review must assess source/fixture semantics, not infer parity from counts. No acceptance credit.
